event.notes: "mode": "auto" means every run resolves this itself — before config.json is even loaded, it asks ESPN for the soonest upcoming card, and if that differs from "name" below it rewrites "name"/"league"/"date", regenerates discovery.title_contains and discovery.search.queries from the new main event's fighters, and clears tracker.picks_videos (a stale roundup URL would just burn a download and a vision pass on the old event's deck). Once this week's card has happened, the next run rolls to whatever's next on its own — no manual retarget. "name"/"league"/"date" below are simply the last-resolved event; edit them by hand only if you delete "mode" and want to pin a specific card again (e.g. a Contender Series week, matched as a substring against ESPN's own event name — punctuation and case ignored, spelling not). "league" pins which scoreboard is searched (ufc / pfl); leave it empty to try UFC then PFL. Add more cards to the top-level "events" array to cover them in the same run — a PFL event the same weekend, say — and the dashboard puts a card selector at the top. If a run logs "No ESPN card found" (or, in auto mode, "No upcoming event found"), something's off with the league or the scoreboard is unreachable — nothing is filtered and off-card fights come back.

Could not retrieve a transcript for the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X8h8G_3by-M! This is most likely caused by:

YouTube is blocking requests from your IP. This usually is due to one of the following reasons:
- You have done too many requests and your IP has been blocked by YouTube
- You are doing requests from an IP belonging to a cloud provider (like AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Azure, etc.). Unfortunately, most IPs from cloud providers are blocked by YouTube.

Ways to work around this are explained in the "Working around IP bans" section of the README (https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api?tab=readme-ov-file#working-around-ip-bans-requestblocked-or-ipblocked-exception).


If you are sure that the described cause is not responsible for this error and that a transcript should be retrievable, please create an issue at https://github.com/jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api/issues. Please add which version of youtube_transcript_api you are using and provide the information needed to replicate the error. Also make sure that there are no open issues which already describe your problem!
